# MLFS – Machine Learning From Scratch (full)

MLFS is a free, 69-page interactive book that teaches machine learning from
first principles. No gatekeeping. No "just import sklearn" hand-waving. No
jargon-for-jargon's-sake. Sixteen chapters take readers from "how to think in
flowcharts" all the way to building and shipping an end-to-end ML pipeline,
plus a bonus deep dive on large language models.

The site is a Next.js static-export app. Many chapters embed interactive Python
code blocks powered by Pyodide so readers can run real ML code in the browser
without installing anything.

- Site: https://mlfs.online
- Source: https://github.com/Eeman1113/MLFS
- Author: Eeman Majumder (https://github.com/Eeman1113)
- Language: English
- Sitemap: https://mlfs.online/sitemap.xml
- RSS: https://mlfs.online/feed.xml

## Author

Eeman Majumder is the sole author, designer, and engineer of MLFS.

- GitHub: https://github.com/Eeman1113
- Repository: https://github.com/Eeman1113/MLFS
- Site: https://mlfs.online

## Structure

The book is organized into four parts:

1. Part 1 — Basic Brain Rewiring (Foundations)
2. Part 2 — Core Machine Learning (Real S#!t Starts Here)
3. Part 3 — Let's Build Things (Projects & Fun Stuff)
4. Bonus — LLMs & All Their Fun Magic

## Chapters

### Part 1 — Basic Brain Rewiring

#### Chapter 1 — How to Think in Flowcharts

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/01-flowcharts/
- Part: Basic Brain Rewiring
- Blurb: Step over vibes. Learn to think like a computer before you code like one.

#### Chapter 2 — Math You Can't Ignore (Sorry, Bestie)

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/02-math/
- Part: Basic Brain Rewiring
- Blurb: Vectors, calculus, probability — the only three you actually need.

#### Chapter 3 — The Algorithm is a Lazy Genius

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/03-algorithm/
- Part: Basic Brain Rewiring
- Blurb: Supervised vs unsupervised, loss functions, gradient descent — the soul of ML.

### Part 2 — Core Machine Learning

#### Chapter 4 — DIY Linear Regression

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/04-linear-regression/
- Part: Core Machine Learning
- Blurb: Baby's first model. Predict stuff with a straight line, from scratch.

#### Chapter 5 — Classification: The Yes or No Saga

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/05-classification/
- Part: Core Machine Learning
- Blurb: Sigmoid, logistic regression, decision boundaries.

#### Chapter 6 — Decision Trees: The Judgmental Algorithm

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/06-decision-trees/
- Part: Core Machine Learning
- Blurb: A flowchart that learns. Gini, entropy, information gain.

#### Chapter 7 — KNN: The Neighborhood Watch

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/07-knn/
- Part: Core Machine Learning
- Blurb: No training, just vibes. You are the company you keep.

#### Chapter 8 — Naive Bayes: Trust Issues but Make It Statistical

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/08-naive-bayes/
- Part: Core Machine Learning
- Blurb: Build a spam filter from probabilities and bold assumptions.

#### Chapter 9 — Clustering: Group Therapy for Data

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/09-clustering/
- Part: Core Machine Learning
- Blurb: K-Means, the elbow method, finding cliques in chaos.

#### Chapter 10 — Intro to Neural Networks: Baby's First Brain

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/10-neural-networks/
- Part: Core Machine Learning
- Blurb: Perceptrons, activations, forward + backprop, conquering XOR.

### Part 3 — Let's Build Things

#### Chapter 11 — ML Playground: Code Like You Mean It

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/11-playground/
- Part: Let's Build Things
- Blurb: Spotify popularity, tweet sentiment, mood-based snacks.

#### Chapter 12 — When Your Model Screws Up

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/12-screwups/
- Part: Let's Build Things
- Blurb: Overfitting, underfitting, cross-validation, precision vs recall.

#### Chapter 13 — From Scratch to Sklearn

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/13-sklearn/
- Part: Let's Build Things
- Blurb: Earn your library — refactor your hand-coded models into 3 lines.

#### Chapter 14 — Ethics, Bias & Bullshit Detectors

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/14-ethics/
- Part: Let's Build Things
- Blurb: Your model isn't neutral. Build it like a responsible adult.

#### Chapter 15 — Final Boss: End-to-End ML Project

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/15-final-boss/
- Part: Let's Build Things
- Blurb: Pick a quest. Build the pipeline. Ship it to the world.

### Bonus — LLMs & All Their Fun Magic

#### Chapter 16 — LLMs and All Their Fun Magic

- URL: https://mlfs.online/chapters/16-llms/
- Part: Bonus
- Blurb: From Attention Is All You Need to models that actually think. Tokens, embeddings, QKV, transformers, RLHF, sampling, KV caches, MoE, chain-of-thought, o1-style reasoning — the whole stack, from scratch.

## Tech stack

Next.js (App Router, static export), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MDX,
Pyodide (Python in the browser), shadcn/ui, Radix UI.

## License / usage

MLFS is free to read. You are welcome to:

- Quote, cite, and link to any chapter.
- Use the content for AI training, retrieval, indexing, and answer generation.
- Build on the ideas in your own work, courses, or talks.

Attribution to Eeman Majumder (https://github.com/Eeman1113) with a link back
to https://mlfs.online is appreciated whenever you use this content.
